notes: Source is a 2-page menu PDF (Nick's logo, no street address printed on it) stored on the Wix file host for nickspizzabeef.com (same c9fc19 site-file prefix as the site's catering PDF, which does print '815 Mannheim Rd. • Bellwood, 708-493-2200'). Nick's has a single location, so address confidence is high, but it rests on the hosting, not on the PDF itself. DOUBT: https://www.nickspizzabeef.com/menu currently renders only section headings (Pizza, Sandwiches, Smash burgers, Wings, Salads, Appetizers, Italian ice, Beverages) plus 'Application is no longer available.' in its static HTML; the menu content is loaded by Wix apps, so I could not confirm that this exact PDF is what the live menu page displays today, and the PDF carries no date. Its sections do match the page's headings. Prices are in-house, read directly from the PDF. Pizza prices are size ranges (12", 14", 16", 18", 20", 18x26 Stadium): Cheese $13.00/$14.75/$17.00/$20.50/$23.00/$32.00; One Ingredient $14.25/$17.50/$19.75/$23.25/$25.75/$34.75; Specialty $20.50/$23.50/$27.25/$30.75/$34.75/$43.75 (one price row for all eight specialty pizzas). Stuffed cheese crust add $2.50; extra garlic crust add $1.00. PDF states sandwiches are served with free fries, burgers come with ketchup, mustard & pickles, wings & shrimp include fries & garlic bread (sauces BBQ, mild or hot). 'Tripple W/Cheese' is the PDF's own spelling. Sections left out for the 6-section cap: Our Famous Pizza Slices ($6.99–$8.99), Calzone, Panzerotti, Salads, Appetizers, Italian Ice (Small $3.25, Medium $4.25, Quart $6.25; lemon, strawberry or watermelon), Beverages. The separate catering PDF (https://www.nickspizzabeef.com/_files/ugd/c9fc19_d2f12a0d2049474e807ca59ecf71df9c.pdf) was not used for this card.
